messages:
ara: Heads up — p99 spike on llama3-13b after the autokernel selector tweak. Saw it ~10:30 on a dedicated rack. profiler points to extra memcpy in KV code path.

mika: saw a similar bump on dedicated-rtg. Only reproduces with chat template + long prefix.

devon: can you paste the perf snippet or flame?

ara: ```
# perf top (sample)
llama_kernel_selector +0x1a3
kv_cache_lookup +0x4f
kv_cache_evict +0x2b
memcpy +0x2d8   <-- dominating cycles
```

mika: hypothesis: rope_theta default calc ended up different for the L3 build, so kernel selector prefers slow path (head-split) for hidden_size=4096 / head_dim=128. chat template adds ~80 prefix tokens, so slice/batching heuristics pick larger slice sizes -> triggers headsplit fallback.

devon: interesting. When you force KERNEL_PREF=fused the p99 dropped ~30% locally?

ara: yeah quick test: `KERNEL_SELECTOR=prefer_fused ./serving --model llama3-13b` p99 back down. Not a long term fix but points to kernel-choice mismatch.

perf-bot: Created perf ticket: PERF-1298 "llama3 kernel selector prefers slow head-split path with chat_template prefixes" linking alloc traces and flamegraph.

mika: dug a bit — KV layout in the new build is slightly unaligned when using our small-quant packing; memcpy shows up when copying prefix KV blocks into GPU staging buffer. Causes extra host-side memtraffic.

devon: patch idea: align KV blocks to 256B in placement and adjust prefetch to chunk on 4x head boundaries. Also add a quick selector override for hidden_size>=4096 and head_dim>=64 to prefer fused L2L3 when seq_len > default_prefix.

ara: proposal steps: 1) add alignment fix in kvbuf allocator (256B), 2) tweak batching heuristic: prefer smaller per-request slice if prefix_share < 0.7, 3) update rope_theta defaults for Llama3-13b to 0.5 to avoid pathological scaling, 4) add e2e perf test (chat template + prefix-heavy) to prevent regression.

mika: created draft PR with allocator change + selector heuristic: https://git.internal/r/3456 — includes microbench harness.

devon: running canary with that PR now on rack-3. Canary config: `batcher.max_slice_tokens=512` `batcher.max_requests=8` `kv.align=256` `kernel_selector.override=prefer_fused`

ara: also add a tiny unit that asserts no memcpy hotspots in perf sample for the microbench. `perf-sanitize` script should fail if memcpy > 5% cycles.

perf-bot: Canary started on rack-3 at 2026-03-18T10:58:40Z. Reporting p50/p90/p99 every 30s.

mika: initial canary numbers: p99 reduced ~28%, p90 ~12%. Still seeing occasional spikes when sequence>900 tokens.

devon: next iterate: reduce max_slice_tokens to 384 for high-prefix routes and enable prefix-shared caching (`prefix_cache=true`) to avoid re-copy.

ara: good. After that we should: audit rope_theta derivation for other model sizes (mixtral/mistral) and add a small matrix test: hidden_size x head_dim x rope_theta combos.

mika: agree. Also add chat-template-specific golden prompts to perf suite so rollout gate catches regressions caused by template changes.

devon: will follow up with perf numbers and link PR once canary finishes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
